crossRefs.note: You will surely wear away, both you, and this people that is with you; for the thing is too heavy for you. You are not…
I spoke to you at that time, saying, “I am not able to bear you myself alone.
Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man…
For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called…
even he shall build Yahweh’s temple; and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule on his throne; and he shall be…
to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these…

translations.web: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
translations.bsb: I cannot carry all these people by myself; it is too burdensome for me.
translations.kjv: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy
translations.asv: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
